guard: The L4018 no-coercion law holds at the library boundary: a builtin or method parameter that takes a primitive refuses a container or function before the host can coerce it. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the argument gate never fires
mutations.expectRed: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.completionMarker: ok every admitted node type is classified against the key guard: coercing (exercised above) or inert, no type unclassified
mutations.cell: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.note: With gateArgs a no-op every declared primitive position opens. The red lands on the cell's FIRST conjunct, `abs({})` -> silent NaN (measured pre-fix), a non-closure shape, so the FAIL prints before any closure could detach a rejection.

mutations.name: free join stops gating its elements
mutations.replace: ["join", fn("join", (_f, a) => (a[0] as unknown[]).join(a[1] as string), { any: [0] })],
mutations.expectRed: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.completionMarker: ok every admitted node type is classified against the key guard: coercing (exercised above) or inert, no type unclassified
mutations.cell: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.note: Elements sit inside the declared container argument, so gateArgs cannot see them; only the element loop does. Under the mutant `join([{a:1}], ",")` silently answers "[object Object]" (measured pre-fix) — the join conjunct runs clean and reds the cell; the record has no closure, so no detached rejection.

mutations.name: string methods lose the gate
mutations.expectRed: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.cell: a library argument where a primitive is needed refuses a container or function with L4018, catchably, and the process survives
mutations.note: NO completionMarker on purpose: under the mutant `"a".repeat(spy)` reaches the host, which calls the program's own toString closure — the red prints at the conjunct (the surfaced error is not L4018) but the detached closure may still crash the process afterwards, and a real red followed by a crash is still KILLED only when no marker is declared.
